column3: This workbook contains all public responses submitted by cities reporting to CDP-ICLEI Track in 2025 to the CDP Cities, States and Regions 2025 questionnaire.
The Excel workbook was created through Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2301).

The first tab labelled 'Summary' contains a list of all cities featured in this dataset, while the remaining tabs contain data for each question in the CDP Cities, States and Regions 2025 Questionnaire.
